limitations: All selected truths are library-present by connectivity; no absent-truth denominator applies.
The harness normalizes mode/charge and does not map precursor_type to adduct, so source polarity/adduct gating is not tested.
Precursor eligibility and observed score/match stages are not chemical-identity validation.
Confidence is unavailable or estimated_uncalibrated; this is not calibrated FDR.

narrow_vs_wide.interpretation: Joint change of MS1 and MS2 tolerances; descriptive only.

source_metadata_audit.interpretation: The normalized benchmark inputs do not preserve source ion mode, charge, or precursor-type metadata; polarity/adduct eligibility in the MassFlow search therefore cannot explain these benchmark calls.

truth_precursor_eligibility_audit.mass_error_summary: absolute query minus truth-reference precursor m/z in Da
truth_precursor_eligibility_audit.tolerance_denominator: configured cosine MS1 half-window in Da
